description: Metadata for public Cohere Labs research pages on https://cohere.com/research. cohere.for.ai and for.ai redirect off-host, so those hosts are not stored. Each row was confirmed with one bounded GET of HTML on cohere.com. Cloudflare challenges, captchas, HTTP 202, Akamai 403s, robots blocks, and off-host redirects are omitted. Rows store the title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Abstracts, bodies, PDFs, and chart data are not stored. A missing date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. creative_commons means only CC0, CC BY, or CC BY-SA. CC BY-NC, CC BY-ND, CC BY-NC-ND, and CC BY-NC-SA stay their own tokens. apache-2.0 and mit stay their own tokens. The product site, docs, and playground are not included. runner_wired is false.
